numeric_contract: trace-enabled run rejects non-binary64 state, forcing, and local ice operands
orientation: sedimentation top_first; public WRF model state bottom_first

unit_contract.NI_state: raw KDM operand interpreted as volumetric number (# m-3) by source equations; incoming host producer basis is not certified here
unit_contract.QI_state: nominal water mass-mixing-ratio coordinate; DEN*DELZ*QI is a nominal state-inventory measure in kg m-2
unit_contract.bottom_comparison: stored-falk equivalent versus applied bottom state outflow is a numerical state-coordinate comparison, not a certified physical surface flux
unit_contract.interface_terms: DEN*DELZ-weighted QI and DELZ-weighted NI departures/arrivals are state-equivalent terms from the actual update recurrence, not a certification of physical flux conservation
unit_contract.legacy_velocity_handoff: post-main-reslope raw VT_i/Vtni values are handed to ice substeps without /DELZ in Legacy; raw falk/outflow/arrival fields are executed algebraic values, not physically certified flux dimensions
unit_contract.trace_suffixes: field suffixes name the nominal coordinate/consumer; they do not assert dimensionally consistent physical fluxes where the legacy handoff is unnormalized
